data.name: Labiba
data.gender_notes: Labiba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Whose Heart is Soft and Sweet. The name Labiba carries the meaning “The Sweet One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Labiba usually hope their child will grow to embody the sweet one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a gentle and compassionate soul
data.etymology: Labiba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Sweet One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Labiba total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: لبابة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لبابة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ل-ب-ب' الذي يعني الفهم العميق و الحكمة. يعتبر اسم لبابة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالفهم و الإدراك العميقين. ورد اسم لبابة في بعض المصادر التاريخية كاسم للنساء في العصر النبوي، مما يضيف إلى قيمته الثقافية و التاريخية.

in_urdu.name: لبابہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: لبابہ نام عربی جڑ 'ل-ب-ب' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے گہری سمجھ اور حکمت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مثبت معانی رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ گہری سمجھ اور ادراک سے وابستہ ہے۔ تاریخی ذرائع میں لبابہ نام کا ذکر نبی کے زمانے میں خواتین کے نام کے طور پر ملتا ہے، جو اس کی ثقافتی اور تاریخی اہمیت کو بڑھاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लബाबा
in_hindi.long_meaning: लबाबा नाम अरबी जड़ 'ल-ब-ब' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है गहरी समझ और حکमत। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सकारात्मक अर्थ रखता है, क्योंकि यह गहरी समझ और ادراک से जुड़ा हुआ है। ऐतिहासिक स्रोतों में लबाबा नाम का उल्लेख नबी के समय में महिलाओं के नाम के रूप में मिलता है, जो इसकी सांस्कृतिक और ऐतिहासिक महत्ता को बढ़ाता है।

in_pashto.name: لبابه
in_pashto.meaning: د ژور د پوهې او حکمت لرونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: لبابه نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ل-ب-ب' ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د ژورې پوهې او حکمت معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې مثبته معنا لري، ځکه چې دا د ژورې پوهې او ادراک سره تړلی دی. په تاريخي سرچينو کې د لبابه نوم د نبي په وخت کې د ښځو د نوم په توګه ياد شوی دی، چې د هغې کلتوري او تاريخي اهميت ته وده ورکوي.

in_english.name: Labiba
in_english.meaning: One with deep understanding and wisdom
in_english.long_meaning: The name Labiba is derived from the Arabic root 'ل-ب-ب' (L-B-B), which means deep understanding and wisdom. In Islamic culture, Labiba is considered a positive name as it is associated with profound insight and perception. Historically, the name Labiba has been mentioned in sources as a name for women during the Prophetic era, adding to its cultural and historical significance. The name Labiba symbolizes intelligence, intuition, and spiritual awareness, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Labiba" in Islamic culture is often associated with kindness, compassion, and a gentle demeanor. The softness and sweetness associated with the name are thought to reflect the qualities of a caring and nurturing individual. In many Islamic cultures, these qualities are highly valued and can be seen as desirable traits for a person.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Labiba" can be seen as a reminder of the importance of having a soft and open heart towards others and towards God. In Islamic teachings, having a compassionate and loving heart is considered a key aspect of living a virtuous and pious life. By bearing a name that represents these qualities, an individual may be more inclined to cultivate and strengthen them in their daily actions and interactions with the world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Sweet One" symbolizes The One Whose Heart is Soft and Sweet. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Labiba serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the sweet one.
